summary: NextSync 0.2.7: adding a sync folder now takes effect immediately (no restart) and the tray Settings icon is white.
changelog: Adding or removing a sync folder in Settings now takes effect immediately: the account runtime subscribes to config changes and starts/stops the folder engine without needing an app restart. Previously the folder was saved but never synchronized until restart.
The Settings entry in the tray menu now uses a fixed-white icon variant, so it renders white on the panel like the cloud glyph instead of dark.
